mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rent_listing ( estate_type, sigungu_code, region_code, umd_name, jibun, building_name, built_year, floor, area_sqm, deposit, monthly_rent, deal_date, latitude, longitude, base_date, created_date, created_nm, del_yn ) VALUES ( #{estateType}, #{sigunguCode}, #{regionCode}, #{umdName}, #{jibun}, #{buildingName}, #{builtYear}, #{floor}, #{areaSqm}, #{deposit}, #{monthlyRent}, #{dealDate}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{baseDate}, NOW(), #{createdNm}, 'N' )
mapper.sql: l.listing_id, l.estate_type, l.sigungu_code, l.region_code, l.umd_name, l.jibun, l.building_name, l.built_year, l.floor, l.area_sqm, l.deposit, l.monthly_rent, l.deal_date, l.latitude, l.longitude, l.base_date
mapper.select: SELECT FROM rent_listing l JOIN school s ON s.school_id = #{schoolId} AND s.del_yn = 'N' WHERE l.del_yn = 'N' AND l.monthly_rent <= #{maxMonthly} AND l.latitude IS NOT NULL AND l.longitude IS NOT NULL AND ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(l.longitude, l.latitude), POINT(s.longitude, s.latitude)) <= #{radiusKm} * 1000 ORDER BY ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(l.longitude, l.latitude), POINT(s.longitude, s.latitude)) LIMIT 30
SELECT FROM rent_listing l WHERE l.listing_id = #{listingId} AND l.del_yn = 'N'
